meta.description: The Xiaofang Smart Remote puts most of your remotes into one small cube: control the TV, air conditioner and fan from your phone, with 360° infrared coverage and over 6,000 supported brands.
meta.spec.description: Xiaofang Smart Remote (CT10W) specifications: 52 × 52 × 53 mm, 102 g, 20–60 kHz infrared, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, 5 V DC power.
award.golden_pin: Winner of the 2016 Golden Pin Design Award (Taiwan)
award.if: Winner of the 2017 iF Product Design Award (Germany)
award.text: We have always set out to make products that are both beautiful and smart. Guided by our philosophy of “just enough design, natural intelligence”, we keep the design simple and restrained: we believe good design should serve to make a product more capable.
xf_page.xi_content: Movie night with your partner? First you hunt down a pile of remotes and try each one to see which appliance it controls.
xf_page.xi_content2: Back home on a hot summer day, dripping with sweat, you want cool air right away, yet the AC always takes ages?
xf_page.xi_content3: Worried that the fan blows on your child too long and gives them a chill? Is there a way to switch it off on a timer?
xf_page.xi_content4: Watching TV, you flick through the channels until you hit static, and still haven't found a show you like?
xf_page.xi_content5: Throw out your remotes: one Xiaofang is all you need.
xf_page.xf_title: One remote for everything: ordinary appliances turn smart in seconds
xf_page.xf_txt: Xiaofang puts most of your remotes into one. Your appliances turn smart in a second, run from your phone, and you never juggle remotes or hunt for one again.
xf_page.xf_title2: Come home to a cool house
xf_page.xf_txt2: On hot days, turn the AC on from the road with Xiaofang, so the rooms are cool before you arrive.
alt.ac_phone: The Gree air conditioner's remote in the ORVIBO Home app
xf_page.xs_title: No more chills from the fan
xf_page.xs_txt: With Xiaofang, your phone runs the fan. Set “Fan off at 2:00 p.m.” in ORVIBO Home before your child's nap.
xf_page.xe_title: Every touch of good design is there to make it more capable
xf_page.xi_txt: 360° infrared coverage with no blind spots
xf_page.xi_txt2: Works with over 6,000 major appliance brands worldwide: air conditioners, TVs, set-top boxes and more.
xf_page.xi_txt3: A high-power infrared emitter reaches up to 8 m.
xf_page.xi_txt4: The top shell, of a special material that lets through up to 89% of infrared light, gives a stronger signal.
xf_page.xi_txt5: One-tap home theater mode switches your appliances on automatically
xf_page.xf_page2: * Actual results may vary slightly with the measuring method; the data comes from lab tests.
xf_page.xn_item: Scan to download and install ORVIBO Home
xf_page.xn_item2: Plug it in and finish setup
alt.product: The Xiaofang Smart Remote, model CT10W
xf_page.xt_table: Before you buy, check how your appliances' remotes talk to them: Xiaofang works only with infrared remote-controlled appliances, not with Bluetooth or RF remotes.
xf_page.data_source_tips: * All the data above is from ORVIBO's lab; actual results may vary slightly with the measuring method.
